notes.title: Version 1.08.03 is out now!
notes.notes:
Did a lot of recfactoring in the back to enable the addition of the landscape module in the future.
There was also a crucial bug in the game, that was brought to my attention by "notaplayer", "BaliStar" and "Rafi". Than you all very much for that, it should now be fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.08.02 is out now!
notes.notes:
Version 1.08.02 is out now:
Bug fixes:
The developer extras were enabled by default, which was not intended. Thank you @DesertSage for bringing this issue to my attention.
I also added a more visual indicator that certain StyleSets are still WIP.
